Sizes: φ60 / φ70 / φ80 / φ90. This row is φ80. Unit: set. Material and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ80 is also a mixing seal, a main-cylinder seal, an S-tube small-end seal and a swing-arm ball. The DN80 clamp is another page. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write swing-cylinder seal φ80 and the quantity in sets. The outline does not complete a blank.
